name: Talude Studio V2.8.2 — Classic UX + Safe Core

checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: O Local Build Manager gere automaticamente um Python 3.12 privado.

checks.name: Git
checks.command: if (Test-Path '.git') { git --version } else { Write-Output 'Git opcional: pasta ZIP sem .git; BUILD/TESTES funcionam sem Git'; exit 0 }
checks.hint: Opcional em pastas ZIP; necessário apenas para Git Pull/clones.

test.name: Instalar dependências Talude Studio
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

test.name: Compilar motor + Studio
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m compileall -q src studio core tests talude_gui.py talude_studio.py

build.name: Instalar dependências de build
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

build.name: Validar motor e Studio antes do EXE
Preparar pasta de build
build.command: if (Test-Path '%WORK%') { Remove-Item '%WORK%' -Recurse -Force }; $short=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioBuild'; if (Test-Path $short) { Remove-Item $short -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '%WORK%', '%LATEST%', '%ARCHIVE%' | Out-Null

build.name: Verificar Talude_V1.exe
build.command: $exe=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioBuild\dist\Talude_V1\Talude_V1.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $exe)) { throw ('Talude_V1.exe não foi gerado: ' + $exe) }; Get-Item $exe | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

build.name: Self-test QtWebEngine + Potree + motor
build.command: $dist=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioBuild\dist\Talude_V1'; Push-Location $dist; try { Remove-Item TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & ./Talude_V1.exe --self-test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (!(Test-Path './TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Self-test não criou relatório' }; Get-Content ./TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt } finally { Pop-Location }

build.name: Preparar Talude Studio portátil
build.command: $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\TaludeStudioBuild'; $pkg=Join-Path $root 'package'; $dist=Join-Path $root 'dist\Talude_V1'; if (Test-Path $pkg) { Remove-Item $pkg -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkg | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse $dist (Join-Path $pkg 'Talude_V1'); Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/START_TALUDE_V1.bat' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/LEIA_ME.txt' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'README.md' $pkg
